backend/main.mo: Defines an actor exposing a query method getAppName that returns “Sabji wala.”
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten 1–2 sentence summaries for major frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and dark mode overrides with applied global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting the page title to “Sabji wala” and loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets the document title and renders the LandingPage.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Sticky header showing the logo and backend-fetched app name with navigation links.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor based on authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides a query hook to fetch the app name from the backend or fall back to a default.
frontend/src/index.css: Theme-focused Tailwind stylesheet defining a fresh-produce color palette for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App bootstrap configuring React Query and Internet Identity provider, then rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Full landing page with hero, informational sections, and themed visuals using BrandHeader.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins for a themed UI, including extended palette and component styles.
project_state.json: Defines the project's current state, required features for the Sabji wala app, and metadata including image requirements and pending requests.
